scripts.build:web: expo export --platform web --clear && node scripts/verify-web-build.cjs && node scripts/export-guides.cjs && npm run build:websites
scripts.test: npm run test -w functions && npm run test:worker
scripts.deploy: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:web && firebase deploy --project daniboy-be1c0
scripts.test:emulators: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-daniboy 'npm test && node tests/firestore-rules.cjs'
scripts.worker: npm run build -w functions && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.worker worker/index.cjs
scripts.worker:studio: npm run build -w functions && node worker/studio.cjs
scripts.worker:studio:install: npm run build -w functions && node scripts/install-studio-worker.cjs
